SMTO-WEB-0022 — The answer cited a note that isn't in SMTO's research

GUID: 86633124-1832-5f67-9d68-f732f639b694
Slug: research-unknown-evidence-reference
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • The answer pointed to a piece of supporting information that SMTO never recorded, so it can't show that part as proven. The research SMTO did gather is still saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait for the run to finish. SMTO sends the answer back to the Model and asks it to use only information from this run's research. This usually happens when the Model mislabels its sources, which it can fix on another pass.
  2. If the run stops, send your question again as a new message. A new request gathers fresh, correctly labelled sources, and reading web pages again changes nothing.
  3. If the run stops and an unchecked answer is acceptable to you, open the Research proof validation card shown in the run and turn off Enforce this check for this run. This shows the answer without confirming that each statement matches what SMTO recorded.

What success looks like

  • The answer appears with each statement linked to a page SMTO read.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't accept made-up source labels or swap in an unrelated source to make the answer pass.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Research proof rejected the completion because a fact or claim references an evidence-span ID that does not exist in the research record's evidence_spans.

What this means

  • A fact or claim names an evidence-span ID that is absent from the research record. This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.

Why this can happen

  • A fact or claim names an evidence-span ID that is absent from the research record.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare evidence_ids against the current evidence_spans map.

How to fix it

  • Raised as research_unknown_evidence_reference from _verify_fact (fact.evidence_ids entry missing) or _validate_answer (claim.evidence_ids entry missing). The claim map must use evidence IDs from the current research packet; replace stale or invented IDs with existing ones or drop the unsupported claim.
  • Replace stale evidence IDs with valid retained references or omit the unsupported claim.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use verified facts or an explicit scoped limitation.

How to verify the fix

  • Every claim reference resolves to the exact retained span.

What not to do

  • Do not fabricate an evidence identifier or substitute an unrelated observation.

Technical notes

  • This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
